_comment: Human-curated work queue for the autonomous issue supplier (Phase 12 #1). The cron supplier files the FIRST item below whose id has not already been turned into a [<id>]-titled issue, applies the aider-fix label, and the Aider Resolver takes it → PR → auto-merge. YOU curate WHAT goes here; the cron only decides WHEN. Rules for good items: clear spec, target file paths in backticks, a tests/... path, small-to-medium scope (the proven range). Add new items at the BOTTOM; processed ids are remembered via existing issue titles so order is stable. Delete or keep the seed examples below as you like.

items.title: Implement in-memory Queue class (queue.js)
items.body:
## Task
Create `src/ralph/utils/queue.js` exporting a `Queue` class.

## Requirements
- Constructor: `new Queue()`
- Methods: `enqueue(item)`, `dequeue()` (returns `undefined` when empty), `size` (getter), `isEmpty` (getter)
- FIFO order guaranteed
- Write tests in `tests/ralph/utils/queue.spec.js` using `@playwright/test`
- Tests must cover: enqueue/dequeue ordering, size tracking, isEmpty, dequeue on empty queue

items.title: Implement concurrency-limited pool runner (pool.js)
items.body:
## Task
Create `src/ralph/utils/pool.js` exporting `run(queue, concurrency)`.

## Requirements
- Accepts a `Queue` instance (from `queue.js`) pre-populated with zero-arg async functions (tasks)
- `concurrency` must be a positive integer; throw synchronously otherwise
- Drains the queue running at most `concurrency` tasks in parallel
- Returns `Promise<Result[]>` in enqueue order (index = insertion order)
- Each `Result`: `{ ok: true, value, durationMs }` or `{ ok: false, error, durationMs }`
- Task rejection/throw → collect error, continue; do not abort
- Measure `durationMs` per task internally with `Date.now()` or `performance.now()`
- Write tests in `tests/ralph/utils/pool.spec.js` using `@playwright/test`
- Tests must cover: ordered results, concurrency cap, error collection, invalid concurrency throws, empty queue

items.title: Implement report aggregator (report.js)
items.body:
## Task
Create `src/ralph/utils/report.js` exporting `aggregate(results)`.

## Requirements
- Accepts `Result[]` as returned by `pool.run()`
- Returns a plain JS object: `{ total, succeeded, failed, avgDurationMs, errors: [string] }`
- `total` = results.length; `succeeded` = count where `ok === true`; `failed` = count where `ok === false`
- `avgDurationMs` = arithmetic mean of all `durationMs` values (0 if empty array)
- `errors` = array of string representations of each `error` where `ok === false`
- Write tests in `tests/ralph/utils/report.spec.js` using `@playwright/test`
- Tests must cover: all-success, all-failure, mixed, empty array, avgDurationMs calculation
